offers.name: Third Time's the Charm
offers.tagline: First class: awkward. Second: better. Third: hooked. 3 classes for the price of 2.

Commercial job: Lift trial-to-member conversion by getting newcomers to the 3-visit mark.
You pay: 3-class pass: ₹3,885.

Mumbai: 3 classes for ₹3,885 (price of 2 singles) — mix barre, powerCycle and Strength Lab (Lab seats at Supreme HQ; Kwality off-peak only), use within 14 days. Kenkere: 3 barre classes for ₹2,835 (counts as the once-in-a-lifetime 2-for-1; replaces the 50% intro in January). Then the standard 15% on a first membership: 1 Month ₹17,203 / ₹12,406.

Why it works: 60.6% of first-timers never take a 2nd class. Purchase within 60 days by month-1 visits: 0 return visits 10.8%, 1 → 43.9%, 2 → 73.3%, 3–4 → 88.6%. The 2-for-1 route converts 20.8% (Bandra 17%). A third class moves people into the 73–89% band.

offers.name: U Up? It's 2027.
offers.tagline: U up? Your mat's been asking about you.

Commercial job: Reactivate lapsed clients in the highest-intent month and get them active before February’s Valentine’s season.
Who qualifies: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned)
You pay: 1M unlimited: ₹17,203 (15% off the ₹20,239 list price).

Lapsed 61–365 days: the standard 15% on 1 Month (₹17,203 / ₹12,406) or a 12-class pack (₹16,735 / ₹11,156). Take 12 classes by 31 Jan and get +5 days (pack buyers: +1 class). Pop-ups: 15% on an 8- or 10-class pack (₹5,891 / ₹7,229) and +1 class for 6 classes by 31 Jan.
Rules: • Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned). No stacking with the spot sale.
Why it works: Bandra is reactivation-led (3,209 lapsed vs 5,065 renewed membership records). Renewal climbs with usage: Bandra members using <50% of sessions renew 49–58% vs 82% at 75%+. The bonus is only paid for attendance that predicts the next renewal.
What to watch: Lapsed buyers; share hitting 12 classes (target 40%); Feb renewal of Jan winbacks.
Model: Plan: 11 buyers × ₹17,203 = ₹189,233 (Mumbai pricing; scaled so offers carry ≤80% of the month).

offers.name: The Baker's Dozen
offers.tagline: 12 months is so 2026. Renew your annual and get 13.

Commercial job: Re-up the annuals that fall due in Dec–Feb and upgrade 3M/6M members to annual.
You pay: annual unlimited: ₹1,86,533 (15% off the ₹2,19,450 list price).

Annual Unlimited at 15% off — Mumbai ₹1,86,533 (list ₹2,19,450), Kenkere ₹1,32,804 (list ₹1,56,240) — for 13 months instead of 12, plus the standard annual perks (2 privates, 4 guest passes, 1 hosted class, monthly trainer check-ins).
Rules: • ≈21.5% effective (annual cap 25%). Annual, 6M and 3M members expiring 1 Dec–28 Feb.
Why it works: Annual is Kwality's #1 product (32 units, ₹51.6L in the last 12 months) and Bandra's #3 (15 units, ₹23.8L). The ANN-2026-25%-KH code gave away ₹9.7L at a flat 25%; this gives less cash away (≈21.5% effective) and adds time, which costs little at spare capacity.
What to watch: Annual re-up rate (target 75%); 3M/6M → annual upgrades.
Model: Plan: 3 buyers × ₹186,533 = ₹559,599 (Mumbai pricing; scaled so offers carry ≤80% of the month).

offers.name: The 57-Hour Hangover Sale
offers.tagline: Hungover? Same. 1 month unlimited, flat ₹15,000. 57 hours only.

Commercial job: Front-load January cash and capture the resolution spike before it cools.
Who qualifies: Everyone, while the capped stock lasts; one per person.
You pay: 1M unlimited: ₹15,000 (26% off the ₹20,239 list price).

1 Month Unlimited at a flat ₹15,000 in Mumbai (list ₹20,239, 26% off) or ₹10,000 at Kenkere (list ₹14,595, 31% off). Fri 1 Jan 00:00 to Sun 3 Jan 09:00 — 57 hours. Capped at 57 memberships per city, 1 per person, activate by 15 Jan.
Rules: • Spot offer, so the >25% cap does not apply. Replaces (does not stack with) the 15% newcomer or lapsed perk. Active members may buy it as their next renewal only if their plan ends before 31 Jan.
Why it works: January is the strongest non-April month in Mumbai (Jan-26: Kwality ₹27.4L, Bandra ₹20.0L; Kenkere ₹11.1L). A capped spot price creates urgency without training clients to wait — only 57 units per city, so the maximum discount exposure is ~₹3.0L in Mumbai and ~₹2.6L in Bengaluru.
What to watch: Sell-out time; share of spot buyers renewing in Feb at standard price (target 55%).
Model: Plan: 14 buyers × ₹15,000 = ₹210,000 (Mumbai pricing; scaled so offers carry ≤80% of the month).

job: Turn Valentine’s-season traffic into first memberships through a mystery-class intro; recruit through members’ love letters; move February renewals onto 3–12 month plans; let lapsed clients come back on the commitment they choose. Every reward is tied to a purchase or a visit.
moment: Key dates: Green Flag Week: Blind Date envelopes at every desk (1 Feb); Galentine’s class (bring a friend free) (13 Feb); Valentine’s Day: Partner Barre (14 Feb); Singles Awareness Day: Hate-Squat Hour (break-up playlist class) (15 Feb).

offers.name: Blind Date (No Catfishing)
offers.tagline: Two classes. You don’t know which. That’s the fun part.

Commercial job: Turn Valentine’s-season curiosity into first memberships without a 50% code.
You pay: 1M unlimited: ₹16,204 (20% off the ₹20,239 list price).

Mumbai: 2 mystery classes in 10 days for ₹999. The format (Barre, powerCycle or Strength Lab) and the trainer stay sealed in an envelope until you walk in; date two is booked at the desk before you leave. Kenkere: 2 mystery Barre classes (trainer and playlist sealed) for ₹709. Pop-ups: the paid trial (≈₹945), with the second class free if it is booked at the desk. Buy within 72 hours of date two and the ₹999 / ₹709 is credited against 1 Month at the standard 15% (₹16,204 / ₹11,697 net). Pop-ups: 8-class pack at 15% (₹5,891).
Rules: • One per phone number. The intro fee is credited only within 72 hours of class 2. Standard 15% only; no stacking.
Why it works: Kenkere’s VDAY50! code (38 uses, ₹2.6L given away at 50%) bought February volume at a huge cost. A booked second visit lifts trial→member from 10.8% to 43.9%, and a mystery format gets newcomers into the class they would never pick, which is usually the one that sells the membership.
What to watch: Second-date booked at the desk (target 70%); trial → member (target 30%).

offers.name: Love Bombing (The Healthy Kind)
offers.tagline: Love bombing, but it’s two free classes and zero manipulation.

Commercial job: Turn members into recruiters; only pay when a new person buys.
Who qualifies: Current members bringing a never-been friend.
You pay: 1M unlimited: ₹17,203 (15% off the ₹20,239 list price).

Every active member gets three printed love letters at the desk (and a WhatsApp version). Each one gives a never-been friend 2 free classes within 14 days. If the friend buys 1 Month or a 12-class pack within 72 hours of class 2: their standard 15% (₹17,203 / ₹12,406; pop-ups 8-class ₹5,891) plus P57 grip socks, and the member gets +5 days (pack: +1 class) per friend who buys, up to 15 days. Partner Barre on Sun 14 Feb counts as class 2.
You get: • Pays only on a new buyer
Rules: • The friend must be new to P57 (phone verified). Member reward: +5 days per buying friend, max 15. Standard 15% for the friend only.
Why it works: Referrals convert 41.2% at Kwality, 22.6% at Bandra, 28.3% at Kenkere and 76.1% at pop-ups, versus 3.8–5.7% for website leads. The 2026 BOGO codes (70 uses, ₹3.1L given) went mostly to existing clients; this one pays out only when a genuinely new person buys.
What to watch: Letters redeemed; new buyers from referral (target +40% vs Feb-26).

offers.name: It’s Not You, It’s Your Schedule
offers.tagline: It’s not you, it’s your schedule. Pick a relationship status.

Commercial job: Bring lapsed clients back by letting them choose the commitment.
You pay: 12-class pack: ₹17,203 (13% off the ₹19,688 list price).

Lapsed 61–365 days pick a relationship status at the standard 15%: Exclusive = 3 Months (₹49,177 / ₹35,879) + 1 extra freeze; Casual = a 12-class pack (₹16,735 / ₹11,156); It’s Complicated = 1 Month (₹17,203 / ₹12,406) + 1 free freeze for the week life gets in the way. Pop-ups: 8-class pack at 15% (₹5,891). Galentine’s class Sat 13 Feb: bring a friend free.
Rules: • Lapsed 61–365 days. Standard lapsed 15% only; freezes have no cash value.
Why it works: Lapsers average 2.6–3.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 6.4 for renewers: they left because the plan did not fit the week, not because of the price. Letting them pick the commitment removes the objection without deepening the discount.
What to watch: Reactivations; mix of Exclusive / Casual / Complicated (target 30% Exclusive).

offers.name: Put a Ring On It
offers.tagline: If you like it, then you should’ve put a 6-month on it.

Commercial job: Move February renewals onto 3–12 month plans with a reason to say yes on the spot.
Who qualifies: Members renewing in February (any expiry date).
You pay: 6M unlimited: ₹96,658 (15% off the ₹1,13,715 list price).

Any February renewal: 3 Months at 15% (₹49,177 / ₹35,879) + a P57 mini-band “ring”; 6 Months at 15% + 1 private session (₹96,658 / ₹69,883); Annual at the standard 20% + the annual perks + your name engraved on the Wall of Commitment. Say yes at the desk and the bell rings, confetti, the class applauds. Pop-ups: 10-class pack at 10% + the mini-band (₹7,655).
Rules: • 3M 16.4% / 6M 19.6% effective (perks at list); annual at the standard 20%. One ring per renewal. No stacking.
Why it works: Members using 75%+ of their sessions renew at 82–88%, and longer plans keep them using them. The best perks sit on the longest plans; nothing is unlocked by a class count, so every renewer qualifies.
What to watch: 3M+ share of renewal value (target 45%); proposals accepted at the desk.

offers.name: Lift Like a Girl

Book a second class before leaving and buy 1 Month or a 12-class pack within 72 hours: the standard 15% (₹17,203 / ₹16,735) plus a free Lab induction seat for a friend.

offers.name: Monogamy Is Overrated
offers.tagline: Committed to one class? Cute. Members who play the field stay longer.

offers.name: Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai
offers.tagline: Bura na mano, renewal hai. 48 hours only.

What to watch: Pass → member (target 35%); buzzer hits (bought within 9 hours).

offers.name: Plus One, Plus Nine
offers.tagline: Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.

Commercial job: Turn the anniversary into the year’s biggest referral month.
Who qualifies: Current members bringing a never-been friend.

Any active member whose never-been friend buys in April gets +9 days (pack members: +2 classes). Three buying friends = a free month. The friend gets the standard 15% and a Cloud Nine tote. Bring Your Barre-stie day (Thu 8 Apr): every member gets a free guest pass.

What to watch: Referral buyers (target 2× April 2026); members reaching three.

offers.name: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work
offers.tagline: We wrote your obituary. You’re not getting out of it that easily.

You pay: 1M unlimited: ₹17,203 (15% off the ₹20,239 list price).

Photo at the Back From the Dead frame; your row at the Throwback Reunion (Sat 24 Apr).
Rules: • Lapsed 61 days–3 years. Standard lapsed 15% + loyalty-year bonus (max 3) = ≤20% effective.
Why it works: Lapsed clients already know the product; what they need is a moment and a reason that is not just a discount. A personal postcard with a dated class beats a generic reminder.
What to watch: Postcards → Séance Class attendance; reactivations (target +30% vs Apr-26).

offers.name: Club Nine: The Founders’ Table
offers.tagline: Nine numbered seats per studio. Founder perks for a year.

9 numbered Annual Unlimited seats per studio at the standard 20% (₹1,75,560 / ₹1,24,992) with the annual perks doubled: 4 privates, 8 guest passes, 2 hosted classes, monthly trainer check-ins, a numbered jacket, your name on the Club Nine wall and 48-hour priority booking all year. Unveiled at the Birthday Bash on Sat 17 Apr.
Rules: • Annual cap 25% (doubled perks at list). 9 seats per studio.
Why it works: Annual buyers are the most valuable members in the book; a numbered seat with doubled perks costs less than a deeper price and gives them something to show off.
What to watch: Seats sold (9 per studio); annual share of April renewals.

offers.name: Spin Class (Literally)
offers.tagline: Renew, then spin. Every spin wins. Feeling brave? Double it.

Commercial job: Full-price-adjacent renewals with a prize everyone talks about.
Who qualifies: Members renewing 1 Month or a 12-class pack.
You pay: 1M unlimited: ₹18,215 (10% off the ₹20,239 list price).

Renew 1 Month or a 12-class pack in April at 10% off (₹18,215 / ₹17,719; Kenkere ₹13,136 / ₹11,813; pop-up 10-pack ₹7,655) and spin the Wheel of Nine. Then choose: keep it, double it by booking 9 classes in your first 21 days, or donate it to a friend as a guest pass.
Rules: • One spin per renewal; published odds; doubled prizes credited only once the 9 classes are attended. ≈19.5% effective on the expected value.
Why it works: Clients who use 75%+ of their sessions renew at 80–86%. The doubling option pays the prize only when the member books the classes that make them renew again; the expected value of a spin is ≈₹1,900 Mumbai / ₹1,350 Bengaluru.
What to watch: April renewal yield vs April 2026; share of spins doubled (target 35%).

offers.name: Moving In Together (The 9-Month Lease)
offers.tagline: Nine years in, we’re ready to move in together. 99 keys. No second batch.

Commercial job: The biggest ticket of the month, carrying members to January 2028.

You pay: 9M unlimited: ₹1,44,999.

A 9-Month Unlimited that exists only in April: Mumbai ₹1,44,999 (a 6-Month plus a 3-Month cost ₹1,71,570), Kenkere ₹1,02,999 (₹1,24,425). 9 freezes (min 3 days each), the anniversary hoodie, a numbered brass studio key and your name on the Lease Wall. 99 numbered keys across Kwality and Supreme HQ, 39 at Kenkere; a live counter on the studio screens.
Rules: • 17.5% Mumbai / 20.0% Bengaluru effective (hoodie at list; freezes have no cash value). 99 / 39 numbered keys, no second batch. April only.
Why it works: A numbered, one-month-only product gives people a reason to buy now without cutting the price of the core memberships. April 2026 was bought with 40–48% codes; scarcity sells the long plan at 17.5–20% instead.
What to watch: Keys sold vs 99 / 39; 6M+ share of April membership revenue (target 50%).

offers.name: The 9:09 Panic Attack
offers.tagline: Plank for your price. Or wait for 9:09 and panic with everyone else.

Plank Your Price at the desk: hold 57 seconds and it is ₹12,999 (Kenkere ₹8,699), 1:57 for ₹12,249 (₹8,199), 2:57 for the floor, ₹11,499 (₹7,699). On Fri 9 Apr, two 99-minute windows from 9:09 am and 9:09 pm give everyone the floor price, no plank needed: siren in studio, countdown on Instagram. Pop-ups: a 9-class pack at ₹6,499 in the same windows.

Why it works: A price you earn with your body is the most Physique 57 thing there is, and every plank at the desk is a show for whoever is waiting. The floor price (23.7% / 24.0%) sits inside the 25% spot cap, and plan revenue is counted at the floor.
What to watch: Packs sold in the two 9:09 windows; pack → membership by June.

offers.name: The Cloud Nine 90
offers.tagline: Ninety classes. One year. Zero commitment issues.

Rules: • Bulk purchase, ≤25% effective. Non-transferable; 12-month validity.
Why it works: The Anniversary Big 85 Flex sold 4 times at Kemps Corner and once at Kenkere House in April 2026; this replaces it at a price inside the bulk cap.
What to watch: Packs sold; classes used per month of the pack.

job: Students home from college fill empty off-peak seats; Mother's Day duos; keep April's buyers attending.

offers.name: Mom Said Get Off the Couch
offers.tagline: Home for the summer and Mom's already said 'do something'?

Commercial job: Fill empty off-peak seats and recruit the next generation of members.

Students and under-25s (ID checked): 8-class pack at 20% off — Mumbai ₹10,500, Kenkere ₹6,972, pop-ups ₹5,544 — valid 45 days, Golden Hours only (Mon–Fri 10 am–12 pm, Sat–Sun 4–7 pm). On sale 1 May–30 Jun.

offers.name: Group Project (Finally, Everyone Pulls Their Weight)
offers.tagline: Group projects: usually one person does all the work. Not here.

Commercial job: Acquire students in groups, where they keep each other attending.
You pay: 8-class pack: ₹9,844 (25% off the ₹13,125 list price).
4+ students buy 8-class packs together in one transaction: 25% off each — Mumbai ₹9,844, Kenkere ₹6,536, pop-ups ₹5,198. Golden Hours validity, 45 days.

offers.name: Mom-entum
offers.tagline: She carried you for 9 months. You can carry her to class.

You pay: 1M unlimited: ₹17,203 (15% off the ₹20,239 list price).

Mother–child pairs (either way round), 1–16 May. If one is new: the newcomer's standard 15% on 1 Month / 12-class, a shared 30-min duo private and a P57 gift for mum (≈₹2,000 retail — confirm). If both are members: renew together at 10% each + the duo private.
Rules: • ≈18% effective for a newcomer, ≈16% for a member renewing.
Why it works: Duos with a booked second class convert best; Mother's Day gives a reason. The perk is a shared session, not a bigger discount.
What to watch: Duos trialled; both-buy rate.

offers.name: Don't Ghost Us After the Party
offers.tagline: Great party. Now show up 8 times in May.

Commercial job: Keep April's buyers paying after April.
Who qualifies: ≈20% effective on 3M, ≈20% on 1M with the private
You pay: 3M unlimited: ₹49,177 (15% off the ₹57,855 list price).
